enrollment.gate_hint.zh-CN: 请使用已录入的指纹验证

enrollment.subtitle.default.en: Press the sensor six times, shifting slightly each time.
enrollment.subtitle.default.zh-CN: 请按压传感器六次，每次稍微移动手指。

enrollment.subtitle.switch.en: This finger will only switch between the two hosts.
enrollment.subtitle.switch.zh-CN: 此指纹仅用于在两台主机之间切换。

enrollment.hint.center.zh-CN: 将指腹按在传感器中央

enrollment.hint.back_to_center.en: Back to center, press once more

enrollment.state.place_finger.en: Place your finger on the sensor...
enrollment.state.place_finger.zh-CN: 请将手指放在传感器上…

enrollment.state.lift_finger.en: Lift your finger, then press again...
enrollment.state.lift_finger.zh-CN: 抬起手指，然后再次按压…

enrollment.state.overlap.en: Too similar — shift your finger and press again
enrollment.state.overlap.zh-CN: 位置过于相似，请移动手指后再次按压

enrollment.error.disconnected.en: Device disconnected before enrollment finished. Reconnect the device and try again.
enrollment.error.disconnected.zh-CN: 指纹录入完成前设备已断开连接。请重新连接设备后再试。

firmware.update_wait.en: Firmware update in progress — please wait.
firmware.update_wait.zh-CN: 固件更新正在进行，请稍候。

feature.description.zh-CN: 每个开关都会立即生效。

feature.sudo.subtitle.en: Touch the device instead of typing your password for sudo
feature.sudo.subtitle.zh-CN: 触摸设备，无需为 sudo 输入密码

feature.polkit.subtitle.en: Touch the device for graphical authorization prompts
feature.polkit.subtitle.zh-CN: 图形化授权提示出现时触摸设备

feature.screen.subtitle.en: Touch the device to unlock the lock screen

feature.lock.subtitle.en: Long-press the sensor to lock the screen

feature.ssh.subtitle.en: Let ssh use the keys on the device
feature.ssh.subtitle.zh-CN: 允许 ssh 使用设备上的密钥

sidebar.bluetooth.starting.zh-CN: 蓝牙：已连接，设备正在启动…

sidebar.tooltip.unpaired.en: The device no longer knows this computer. Link it again from the Device page.
sidebar.tooltip.unpaired.zh-CN: 设备已不认识这台电脑，请从“设备”页面重新绑定。

sidebar.tooltip.bluetooth_only.en: Bluetooth only lets this computer see the device. Link it so the device can authenticate you.
sidebar.tooltip.bluetooth_only.zh-CN: 蓝牙只能让这台电脑看到设备，请完成绑定后才能使用设备认证。

sidebar.reading_params.en: Reading connection parameters from the device…
sidebar.reading_params.zh-CN: 正在从设备读取连接参数…

sidebar.read_params_failed.en: Could not read the connection parameters: %{error}

sidebar.read_params_unavailable.en: Could not read the connection parameters.

sidebar.connection.latency.en: Peripheral latency: %{value} intervals (up to %{effective} ms between packets)
sidebar.connection.latency.zh-CN: 外设延迟：%{value} 个间隔（数据包间最长 %{effective} ms）

sidebar.connection.long_enough.en: Long enough for linking and SSH signing.
sidebar.connection.long_enough.zh-CN: 连接参数足够支持绑定和 SSH 签名。

sidebar.connection.too_short.en: Too short for linking and SSH signing (the device needs at least %{minimum} ms and asks this computer for %{requested} ms). If linking fails, disconnect and reconnect the device.
sidebar.connection.too_short.zh-CN: 参数过短，无法可靠支持绑定和 SSH 签名（设备至少需要 %{minimum} ms，并要求这台电脑使用 %{requested} ms）。如果绑定失败，请断开并重新连接设备。

auth.body.agent.en: The agent is requesting permission to run a command. Touch fingerprint to approve:
auth.body.agent.zh-CN: 代理请求执行命令的权限。请触摸指纹设备以批准：

auth.body.fingerprint.en: Touch the fingerprint sensor to authenticate
auth.body.fingerprint.zh-CN: 请触摸指纹传感器完成认证

auth.cli.agent_help.zh-CN: 代理授权模式（显示命令和倒计时）

auth.cli.command_help.zh-CN: 被包装的命令（仅代理模式）

notification.device_unpaired.en: Device is no longer paired with this computer — run 'immurok-cli pair' to pair again
notification.device_unpaired.zh-CN: 设备已不再与这台电脑绑定，请运行“immurok-cli pair”重新绑定

device.empty_slot_hint.en: To fill this slot, open immurok on that computer and click "Link This Computer".
device.empty_slot_hint.zh-CN: 要填充此槽位，请在另一台电脑上打开 immurok，然后点击“绑定此电脑”。

device.foreign_slot_hint.en: Linked to another computer. Link this computer first to manage this slot.
device.foreign_slot_hint.zh-CN: 此槽位已绑定另一台电脑。请先绑定这台电脑后再管理此槽位。

device.not_connected.en: Device not connected. Link status will appear once connected.
device.not_connected.zh-CN: 设备未连接。连接设备后将显示绑定状态。

device.no_two_hosts.en: This firmware does not support two hosts.

device.host_unverified.en: Could not verify which host slot belongs to this computer.
device.host_unverified.zh-CN: 无法确认哪个主机槽位属于这台电脑。

device.both_slots.en: Both host slots are in use. To swap one out, unlink it on that computer first.
device.both_slots.zh-CN: 两个主机槽位都已使用。如需更换，请先在对应电脑上解除绑定。

device.dual_hint.en: This device can be linked to up to two computers. Touch the switch fingerprint to move between them.
device.dual_hint.zh-CN: 此设备最多可绑定两台电脑。触摸切换指纹即可在两台电脑之间切换。

device.confirm_unlink_title.zh-CN: 解除与这台电脑的绑定？

device.confirm_unlink_body.en: The device clears this computer's host slot and the link key stored here is deleted. Fingerprints and keys on the device, and the other host's link, are not affected.
device.confirm_unlink_body.zh-CN: 设备将清除这台电脑的主机槽位，并删除本机保存的绑定密钥。设备上的指纹和密钥，以及另一台电脑的绑定不会受到影响。

device.host_unlink_body.en: That computer will no longer be able to authenticate with this device until it links again. Requires one touch of an enrolled finger.
device.host_unlink_body.zh-CN: 在重新绑定前，那台电脑将无法使用此设备进行认证。需要触摸一次已录入的指纹。

device.touch_unlink.en: Touch an enrolled finger on the device to confirm unlinking the other host.
device.touch_unlink.zh-CN: 请触摸设备上的已录入指纹，以确认解除另一台主机的绑定。

firmware.plan_resume.zh-CN: 计划：继续未完成的更新

firmware.plan_bridge.zh-CN: 计划：两步更新（中间版本 %{from} → %{to}）

firmware.update_complete.en: Update complete — device is now on %{version}.
firmware.update_complete.zh-CN: 更新完成——设备当前版本为 %{version}。

firmware.power_warning.en: Do not power off the device.

firmware.old_signing.en: Firmware outdated (old signing era) — update to keep unlocking and key operations working. %{status}
firmware.old_signing.zh-CN: 固件已过时（旧签名版本）——请更新以继续使用解锁和密钥功能。%{status}

keys.empty.otp.title.zh-CN: 添加第一个 OTP 条目

keys.empty.otp.subtitle.en: Generates a 6-digit code after you touch the device
keys.empty.otp.subtitle.zh-CN: 触摸设备后生成 6 位验证码

keys.empty.api.title.zh-CN: 添加第一个 API 密钥

keys.empty.api.subtitle.en: Shows the stored value after you touch the device
keys.empty.api.subtitle.zh-CN: 触摸设备后显示保存的值

keys.empty.ssh.title.zh-CN: 添加第一个 SSH 密钥

keys.empty.ssh.subtitle.en: Public key can be copied; signing goes through the SSH agent
keys.empty.ssh.subtitle.zh-CN: 可复制公钥；签名通过 SSH agent 完成

keys.delete_tooltip.en: Delete (requires a touch on the device)
keys.delete_tooltip.zh-CN: 删除（需要触摸设备确认）

keys.keystore_full.en: Keystore full — delete an entry first
keys.keystore_full.zh-CN: 密钥库已满——请先删除一个条目

keys.delete_confirm_body.en: This requires a touch on the device and cannot be undone.
keys.delete_confirm_body.zh-CN: 此操作需要触摸设备确认，且无法撤销。

keys.touch_delete.en: Touch the device to confirm deletion…
